title: workspace-map options
description: Options for the workspace-map plugin (sidecar config.json or the plugins entry in opencode.json).

inject.description: How much to inject into the session context.

injectStrategy.description: first = full once per session; changed = full when the map changes else digest; always = full every request.

summarizer.description: outline = deterministic, zero model cost; model = prose via ctx.generate.text (background, never blocks the hook); lsp = LSP-backed symbols (uses ctx.lsp, zero model cost).

summaryModel.description: Model ref for summarizer: 'model'; defaults to the session default model.

refreshOnWrite.description: Re-summarize files changed by write/edit tools.

forceWalkOnNewSession.description: Force a fresh directory walk on the first injection for each new session, even if cache is valid. Ensures new files are detected.

injectAllFiles.description: Include summaries for all files in injection (up to maxSummaries), not just changed/recent files. When false, only changed and recently accessed files get summaries.

summaryPriority.description: Glob patterns for files that should always get priority in summaries (e.g., ["index.ts", "config/**", "src/cli/**"]). These files are always included in summaries when injectAllFiles is true.

summaryLengthByExt.description: Per-extension summary length limits in characters (e.g., {"ts": 500, "md": 2000}).

ignore.description: Extra directory/file names or glob patterns to skip at any depth.

ignoreExtra.description: Additional directory/file names or glob patterns to skip at any depth.

include.description: Glob patterns to force-include files that would otherwise be skipped.

walkConcurrency.description: Max concurrent directory walks. 'auto' detects optimal value based on filesystem latency.

summaryLength.description: Model summary length: short (1 sentence), medium (2-3 sentences), long (4-5 sentences).

autoTune.description: Auto-detect project type and tune options (monorepo, language, framework).

exportJsonl.description: Enable JSONL export of summaries via workspace_map tool (action: export).

exportJsonlPath.description: Output path for JSONL export (relative to workspace root).

lspMaxSymbols.description: Max symbols to fetch from LSP per file.

includeReverseDeps.description: Build and include reverse dependency index (which files import each file).

preferLspFor.description: File extensions (without dot) where LSP summarizer is preferred over global setting.

fallbackChain.description: Fallback order when preferred summarizer fails.

lspFallbackOnTimeout.description: Fall back to next summarizer in chain when LSP times out.

lspFallbackOnError.description: Fall back to next summarizer in chain when LSP returns an error.

summarizerPreference.description: Per-language summarizer preferences. When configured, overrides the global 'summarizer' for matching extensions.

debounceMs.description: Debounce time for file change events in milliseconds.

batchChanges.description: Batch multiple file changes before re-summarizing.

batchTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for batching changes in milliseconds.

watch.description: Watch mode configuration for real-time file updates.

inputTokenPriceUsd.description: Price per input token in USD (e.g., 0.0000015 = $1.50 per 1M tokens).

outputTokenPriceUsd.description: Price per output token in USD (e.g., 0.000006 = $6.00 per 1M tokens).

logIntervalMs.description: Interval for logging cost summary in milliseconds.

costTracking.description: Cost tracking configuration for token usage and estimated costs.

autoDetectGenerated.description: Automatically detect and skip generated files during summarization.

generatedPatterns.description: Glob patterns for generated files to skip summarization. Used when autoDetectGenerated is true.
